summary: The top bar's tooltip builder read whole, the five builders it hands off to, and CModifier's slots 6 to 9 that list a modifier's contributors; BuildModifierEffectsText corrected to the definitions' initialiser.

addresses.name: CTopBar::BuildTooltip
addresses.signature: void __thiscall CTopBar::BuildTooltip(CTopBar* this, GuiTooltipText* out, CGuiObject* element)
addresses.comment:
**Slot 5** of CTopBar (vftable 0x15D2C90), 41 keys, and the whole top bar's number set: IC_NUMBER_IRO, WASTED, AVAILABLE, BASE, FROM_TECHNOLOGY, LEND_LEASE_RECEIVED_VALUE and _MAX_VALUE, every resource as _IRO/_DRO (ENERGY, METAL, RAREMAT, CRUDE_OIL, FUEL, SUPPLIES, MONEY), DISSENT, DIPLOINF, NATIONAL_UNITY, ESPIONAGE, FREE_SPIES, OFFICERS, MANPOWER, PRODUCED, UPKEEP, DAILY. Extent 0x6CCB80..0x6CEF37, `ret 8`.

**It is mouse-dependent and therefore close to useless to a DLL that wants one specific number**: its first act is `mov ecx,[this+0x380]; call [[ecx]+0x10]` - slot 4 of the hovered element - and it bails when that is false or when [+0x24] is null. It is also the caller of BuildGoodsLedgerTooltip (seven times, one per goods) at 0x6CCCE1..0x6CCEDB and of BuildStratWarfareTooltip at 0x6CCBED. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-uinumbers.md. **Read whole 2026-10-11.** The second argument is the element under the mouse. After the strategic warfare window, it answers by the element's name (its slot 17): the seven resource numbers give BuildGoodsLedgerTooltip (fuel and supplies nothing for a government in exile); ic_number IC_NUMBER_IRO (WASTED, BASE, AVAILABLE), FROM_TECHNOLOGY, the contributors to MODIFIER_GLOBAL_IC and the lend-lease lines; each icon_* its *_IRO with *_DRO delayed; dissent_number BuildDissentTooltip; diplomacy_number DIPDETAILS_IRO; national_unity_number BuildNationalUnityTooltip; espionage_number FREE_SPIES; leadership_number BuildOfficerTooltip; manpower_number GetManpowerDetailsText; the seven topbarbutton_* DISABLED_IN_SCENARIO when disabled in a scenario. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-topbartooltip.md, section 1, 3 to 9.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole and the IC and diplomacy arms read off the listing (0x6CCF18..0x6CD6B0, 0x6CE3C1..).
addresses.revises: Every arm described; the arguments typed.

addresses.name: BuildGoodsLedgerTooltip
addresses.signature: Hoi3CString* __stdcall BuildGoodsLedgerTooltip(CCountry* country, Hoi3CString* out, int goods)
addresses.comment:
**One goods category's whole daily ledger as text, and the only place all fifteen of CCountry's per-goods arrays are named at once.** Extent 0x4F3000..0x4F4B5E, `ret 0xC`, returns its `out` (`mov esi,[ebp+0xc]` at 0x4F4AFB). The argument order is read off the call sites, not guessed: `push goods; push &out; push country; call` at 0x6CCCD9..0x6CCCE1. Fourteen call sites - seven in CTopBar slot 5 (0x6CCB80), one per category, the rest around 0x801AA9.

Every localisation key in it is immediately preceded by the load of the value it labels, so the mapping is read: RES_PROD = country + goods*4 + 0x778 (home_produced), RES_CONVOYED_IN +0x79C (convoyed_in, suppressed for goods 0 and 1 - supplies and fuel), RES_CONVOYED_OUT +0x7C0, RES_TRADED_AWAY +0x7E4, RES_REPAID_AWAY +0x82C, RES_INC_DEBT +0x850, RES_TRADED_FOR +0x874, RES_CONVERTED +0x8BC (conversion_made) and +0x8E0 (conversion_used, shown negated), RES_FROM_PUPPETS +0x904 (tribute_received), RES_SENT_TO_MASTER +0x928 (tribute_sent, shown when negative - which confirms it is held negative), RES_USED +0x994 (usage), RES_INTO_NET +0x9B8 (sent_to), RES_SHIPPED_BACK +0x9DC (sent_back). The index is the CGoodsPool index: 0 supplies, 1 fuel, 2 money, 3 crude oil, 4 metal, 5 energy, 6 rare materials.

**So five pools the record carried as unknown or unused have names**: +0x7B8 is convoyed_out (which the convoy-economy comment already called ConvoyedOut - a convergence, trap 14's good case), +0x7DC traded_away, +0x824 repaid_away, +0x848 income_from_debt, +0x86C traded_for. **BiceLib should read those fields rather than call this.** See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-uinumbers.md. **Its text, 2026-10-11:** RES_CHANGE with the day's change (green with a plus at or above 0, red below), then a line per pool in a fixed order where it is not 0 - the gains green with a plus, the losses red and negated, except RES_SENT_TO_MASTER, which is green with a plus - then "\n" and the contributors to the good's global modifier (CModifier slot 9), the kind out of a seven-entry table built at 0x4F4AB0. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-topbartooltip.md, section 3.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole; the tribute line's colour off listing 0x4F4556..0x4F4594.

addresses.name: GetManpowerDetailsText
addresses.comment:
**The only reference to `MANPOWER_DETAILS_IRO` in the image.** It reads the country's `+0xA9C` and `+0xAA0`, formats each with `FormatFixedPoint`, and replaces `$NEED$` and `$USED$`.

**The whole of it exists twice**, once at two decimals and once at one, chosen at `0x2D0639` by whether the need reaches 10000. It goes on to build `MANPOWER_DETAILS_DRO` in a second string. **It fills a whole GuiTooltipText, 2026-10-11** - it initialises all three strings, the position and `below` - text MANPOWER_DETAILS_IRO and delayed MANPOWER_DETAILS_DRO (MONTHLY from GetMonthlyManpowerGain, BASE = max_manpower/1000 x 0.5 / (GLOBAL_MANPOWER_MODIFIER/1000 + 1 + technology manpower gain/1000) in floats, %.3f), then the contributors to modifier 4, the technology line and the contributors to modifier 6. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-topbartooltip.md, section 9.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; the call at 0x6CECC0 pushes the tag and a GuiTooltipText; the writes to out +0x2C, +0x48, +0x54 and +0x58.
addresses.revises: The out argument is a GuiTooltipText, not a string; the delayed half described.

addresses.name: InitModifierDefinitions
addresses.comment: **The global initialiser of the modifier definitions**, not a tooltip: 108 times over it allocates 0x2C bytes, builds a name, and calls CModifierDefinition_Construct (0x456D50) with the id in EDX, a save token and two flags, then ModifierDefinitionDatabase::Add. The 108 'localisation keys' are the definitions' names, and they are what reversing/scripts/modifierIds.py reads. Extent 0x456E00..0x459345, one caller (0x636779). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-topbartooltip.md, section 10.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x456E00..: the operator new(0x2C), the constructor and the Add in each block.
addresses.revises: Renamed from BuildModifierEffectsText: it builds the definitions and writes no text.

addresses.name: BuildDissentTooltip
addresses.comment: dissent_number's tooltip: DISSENTV_IRO with CHANGE the day's change from GetDissentChange, coloured and to two places by FormatFixed15 (rounded); the contributors to MODIFIER_DISSENT under DISSENTV_IRO2; where dissent is not 0, the scaled dissent copy's every value (+0xB1C, slot 7) under DISSENTV_IRO3. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-topbartooltip.md, section 5.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; `ret 8`; the call at 0x6CE20B pushes out and the country.

addresses.name: BuildNationalUnityTooltip
addresses.comment: national_unity_number's tooltip: §Y + unity (+0x10B8) to three places + %; the three strategic warfare impacts (STW_CONV, STW_ALLIES, STW_BOMB) and the contributors to MODIFIER_NATIONAL_UNITY under STRMONTHLY_CHANGE, or NO_CURR_EFFECTS_ON_NU; the contributors to MODIFIER_NATIONAL_UNITY_EFFECT under EFFECT_SIZE_MOD_NU. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-topbartooltip.md, section 7.

addresses.name: BuildOfficerTooltip
addresses.comment: leadership_number's tooltip: OFFICER_NUMBER2_IRO with OFFICERS (+0xC4), DIVISIONS (+0xC8), NEED (+0xD0) and DAILY = the officer slider's effective share x leadership x LEADERSHIP_TO_OFFICERS x (1 + MODIFIER_OFFICER_RECRUITMENT), then the contributors to MODIFIER_OFFICER_RECRUITMENT. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-topbartooltip.md, section 8.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; bare `ret`; the tag in ECX goes to CCountryTag::GetCountry; the caller pops 4.

addresses.name: CModifier::DescribeContributors
addresses.signature: Hoi3CString* __thiscall CModifier::DescribeContributors(CModifier* this, Hoi3CString* out, int kind, int scale) @EAX
addresses.comment: Slot 9. With no contributors and a value of `kind`, its own line (slot 8). Then each contributor in the order added: a newline where the text grew since the last, the contributor's own slot 9, headed by a name + ": " where its slot 10 says so (only CProvinceModifier), trimmed. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-topbartooltip.md, section 10.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled and listed; `ret 0xC`; callers pass scale 1000.

addresses.name: CModifier::DescribeOwnValue
addresses.signature: Hoi3CString* __thiscall CModifier::DescribeOwnValue(CModifier* this, Hoi3CString* out, int kind, int scale) @EAX
addresses.comment: Slot 8: slot 6's name + ": " + a colour by the definition's more_is_better (+0x29) + "+" where positive + the value (x100 to one place and % where the definition's percent, +0x28, is set; else to two places) + §W. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-topbartooltip.md, section 10.

addresses.name: CModifier::DescribeAllValues
addresses.comment: Slot 7: every kind with a value, newline-separated, as the kind's localised name + ": " + the colour, sign and figure of slot 8. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-topbartooltip.md, section 10.

addresses.name: CModifierDefinition_Construct
addresses.no_signature: The name arrives as a 0x1C-byte string by value between the token and the two flags, with the id in EDX: definition@stack:4, token@stack:8, name@stack:0xC..0x27, percent@stack:0x28, more_is_better@stack:0x2C.
addresses.comment: Builds a CModifierDefinition: vftable 0x15BC4E4, name +4, save token +0x20, id +0x24 (from EDX), percent +0x28 and more_is_better +0x29. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-topbartooltip.md, section 10.

addresses.name: FormatFixed15
addresses.signature: Hoi3CString* __stdcall FormatFixed15(Hoi3CString* out, int decimals, __int64 value) @EAX
addresses.comment: A 48.15 number as text: value / 32768 through sprintf with %.0f to %.4f by `decimals` - so rounded, where FormatFixedPoint cuts. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-topbartooltip.md, section 5.

addresses.name: FormatFloat3
addresses.no_signature: The float arrives in XMM0 and the out string on the stack.
addresses.comment: A float as text through sprintf("%.3f"). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-topbartooltip.md, section 9.

addresses.name: CDistributionSetting_EffectiveShare
addresses.comment: A slider's effective share as a 48.15 number: its base share (+0x10) times its factor (+8), shifted right by 15. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-topbartooltip.md, section 6.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; bare `ret`; reads EAX and ESI first.

addresses.name: CCountry::GetOfficers
addresses.comment: The officers at +0xC4, copied out. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-topbartooltip.md, section 8.

struct_fields.name: percent
struct_fields.comment: Set where the kind is shown as a percentage: CModifier slots 7 and 8 write it x100 to one place with %, else to two places. The push nearest the name in each InitModifierDefinitions block. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-topbartooltip.md, section 10.

struct_fields.name: more_is_better
struct_fields.comment: Set where a positive value is good: slots 7 and 8 colour it green above 0 and red below, the other way round where clear. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-topbartooltip.md, section 10.
